description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange, which models a schema interchange format for HTMLPurifier configuration, including properties for namespaces and directives, and methods to add and validate these components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange
classes.description: Represents a schema interchange format with properties for application name, namespaces, directives, and methods to add and validate them.

methods.name: addNamespace
methods.description: Adds a namespace object to the namespaces array, throws exception if namespace redefinition occurs.

methods.name: addDirective
methods.description: Adds a directive object to the directives array, throws exception if directive redefinition occurs.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the interchange schema using a dedicated validator object.
